_provenance.purpose: WS2 T3.2 Step 2 - compositional cardinal-number generation data, shared by faTextNormalize.ts and fa/text.rs
_provenance.status: landed Step 2 (data only) - not yet consumed by either implementation
notes: cardinals0to99 is a closed, fully-lexicalized irregular range (same linguistic joint every language in this file uses) - hundred/thousand/million below are the genuinely open-ended, regular, recursively-composable part this task's 'no cap, ever' requirement targets.
American convention: no 'and' before the remainder ('two hundred thirty-four', not 'two hundred and thirty-four').

Values whose composed reading contains a space are NOT representable by the FA tokenizer today (no vocab has a literal space char) - representability depends on the multi-word tokenizer extension scoped in alongside Step 3, not on this data file alone.

yearReading.rationale: mirrors matcher convention including its x00–x09 quirk; changeable as data.
yearReading.matcherParityNote: The x00–x09 cardinal fallback (n % 100 < threshold, e.g. 1900-1909, 2000-2009) is a known matcher defect (textNormalize.ts's digitTokenToWords, textNormalize.ts:91) being deliberately mirrored here, not independently corrected - if the matcher's threshold or behavior is ever corrected, this policy must be updated in the same change. The two sides must not be fixed independently.
yearReading.note: DETERMINED (operator ruling, Step 3b-ii, per t32-step3b-i-year-reading-measurement.md's option 1): selectionPolicy now encodes the matcher's full conditional rule as data (n % 100 >= threshold -> 'pair', else -> 'compound'), matching the matcher value-by-value across the whole 1100-2999 range instead of a single blanket constant. 'pair' = digit-pair reading (e.g. 'nineteen ninety-eight'); 'compound' = literal arithmetic cardinal (e.g. 'one thousand nine hundred ninety-eight'). Still consumed by nothing - Step 3b-iii wires this into faTextNormalize.ts/fa/text.rs.

ctcMarginExposure.measured: WS2 T3.2 Step 2 (.work-phase4/session-ws2-36/step2-ctc-margin-measurement.md) - real production chunk plans, real forced_align T/L/R math (T from the shipped model.onnx's actual conv chain, L/R from this module's own normalizer + fa_viterbi.rs's count_repeats), across 3 real corpora (v6 280 chunks, 173 118 chunks, spanish 5 chunks). Independently cross-checked once against live ONNX inference on the thinnest-margin corpus (173): zero chunks scored the CTC_INFEASIBLE_FALLBACK_SCORE signature, matching the derived-formula result of 0 chunks at margin<=0 today.
ctcMarginExposure.finding: A year-reading misread that selects 'compound' where selectionPolicy's own rule says 'pair' costs delta(L+R) = +16 in forced_align's T>=L+R feasibility budget (measured on 1998: pair='nineteen ninety-eight' L=21 R=1 vs. compound='one thousand nine hundred ninety-eight' L=38 R=0 - compound is structurally longer for any year whose last two digits are >=10, i.e. 90% of years by construction of the threshold). Applied to every real chunk's already-measured T-(L+R) margin, this flips exactly 2 of 403 real chunks across all 3 corpora from feasible to infeasible (TooManyRepeats, whole-chunk placeholder timing): both in the 173 corpus - chunk 84 (margin 9, 9-16=-7) and chunk 91 (margin 13, 13-16=-3). v6 (worst real margin 32) and spanish (worst real margin 243, and no two-candidate misread exists for es at all - single fixed 'compound' policy) have zero exposure at this delta. de's own pair/hundertgruppe-vs-compound delta is the same shape as en's but was not measured - de never appears in any of the 3 corpora, so there is no real chunk to check it against.
ctcMarginExposure.reachableTodayNote: No corpus among v6/173/spanish contains a year-shaped (bare 4-digit, in-range) token at all - grepped all three real fa_production_chunks.json text fields for \b\d[\d,.]*\b; v6 and 173 have zero digit tokens of any kind, spanish has exactly one ('12', not year-shaped). The 2-chunk exposure above is therefore an injected/hypothetical measurement (delta applied on top of each chunk's real margin), not an observed production failure - nothing in the pipeline has ever actually hit this today.
ctcMarginExposure.mitigationNotBuilt: Splitting a chunk that carries a year-shaped token with insufficient T-(L+R) headroom at plan time (before a misread could tip it into TooManyRepeats) is the obvious mitigation for the 2 exposed chunks, and is deliberately NOT built - nothing in any currently-shipped corpus exercises it, so it would ship as unverifiable, unmeasurable dead code against real data.
ctcMarginExposure.revisitTrigger: The arrival of any real corpus (a v6/173/spanish successor, or a new one) whose production chunk text contains a year-shaped digit token - at that point, re-run this same margin measurement (script: .work-phase4/session-ws2-36/measure-ctc-margin.ts, or its successor) against that corpus's real chunk plan before deciding whether the mitigation above is now worth building.
